title: Implement structured compact summary path with no-tools enforcement
objective: Upgrade Go summary generation from flattened prompt-plus-text to a structured message flow that preserves more conversation fidelity and enforces no-tool behavior.
implementation_scope: Add a structured summarization API that sends conversation messages plus the compact prompt as distinct provider messages where supported.
Retain fallback to the current flattened text path only for providers that cannot support the structured path.
Ensure summary calls disable thinking/tool use or provide an explicit can-use-tool denial equivalent.
Preserve tool_use inputs, tool_result content, assistant metadata, timestamps where available, and injected attachments in the summarizer input.
Keep GetCompactPrompt and FormatCompactSummary compatible with existing tests.
out_of_scope: Do not implement prompt-cache-sharing fork in this task unless the provider/query abstractions already make it trivial.
Do not change the nine-section prompt content except where necessary for structured input separation.
acceptance_criteria: A test proves tool_use input details reach the summarizer path.
A test proves summary generation does not expose ordinary tools to the compact model.
Flattened fallback remains covered and produces the previous summary wrapper.
CompactionResult summaryMessages are populated from the structured path.
risks: Provider abstractions may differ in support for tool disabling and system prompts.
Structured path must not accidentally mutate the live query messages.
dispatch_prompt: Implement a structured compact summarization path for Go that preserves message fidelity and prevents tool calls, with a safe fallback for unsupported providers.
